description: Codex app-server telemetry across classic and native OTLP Application Insights. Includes the unnamespaced and coding-agent service roles with exact identity filters. Separates response usage from completed-turn counters, preserves missing measurements and attribution, and compares tool metrics with deduplicated logs without double counting. Cost estimates use a USD price map generated from the FinOps Hubs Prices() function for the active GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol Global Standard meters. Resource navigation remains portable.

panels.description: Sum of codex.usage.total_tokens on handle_responses spans that report usage. This is a response-usage population, not completed-turn totals. Unavailable model prices are not converted to $0; unsupported spend estimates were replaced with measured tokens.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         reasoning = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.reasoning_output_tokens'])
| where isnotnull(total)
| summarize measured = countif(total >= 0), tokens = sumif(total, total >= 0)
| project tokens = iff(measured > 0, tokens, real(null))

panels.description: Uses codex.tool.call metric sums when present for a service role/tool; otherwise uses tool_result logs deduplicated by role, conversation ID and call ID. Sources are never added for the same role/tool. A small cross-resource difference can reflect exporter coverage or metric emission timing.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let metricCounts = customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'codex.tool.call'
| extend role = iff(cloud_RoleName == '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', cloud_RoleName), tool = tostring(customDimensions['tool']),
         outcome = tobool(customDimensions['success'])
| extend tool = iff(isempty(tool), 'Not reported', tool)
| where valueSum >= 0
| summarize total = sum(valueSum), failures = sumif(valueSum, outcome == false),
            successes = sumif(valueSum, outcome == true),
            unknown = sumif(valueSum, isnull(outcome)) by role, tool
| where total > 0;
let logCounts = traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where tostring(customDimensions['event.name']) == 'codex.tool_result'
| extend role = iff(cloud_RoleName == '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', cloud_RoleName),
         conversation = tostring(customDimensions['conversation.id']),
         call = tostring(customDimensions['call_id']),
         tool = tostring(customDimensions['tool_name']),
         outcome = tobool(customDimensions['success']),
         duration_ms = todouble(customDimensions['duration_ms'])
| where isnotempty(conversation) and isnotempty(call)
| extend tool = iff(isempty(tool), 'Not reported', tool)
| summarize timestamp = min(timestamp), outcomes = make_set_if(tostring(outcome), isnotnull(outcome), 3),
            durations = make_set(duration_ms, 3), tool = take_any(tool)
            by role, conversation, call
| extend outcome = iff(array_length(outcomes) == 1, tobool(outcomes[0]), bool(null)),
         duration_ms = iff(array_length(durations) == 1, todouble(durations[0]), real(null))
| join kind=leftanti (metricCounts | project role, tool) on role, tool
| summarize total = todouble(count()), failures = todouble(countif(outcome == false)),
            successes = todouble(countif(outcome == true)),
            unknown = todouble(countif(isnull(outcome))) by role, tool;
union (metricCounts | extend source = 'Metrics'), (logCounts | extend source = 'Logs')
| summarize sources = count(), calls = sum(total)
| project calls = iff(sources > 0, calls, real(null))

panels.description: Turn-level token counters from session_task.turn, separate from response-usage totals. Missing usage is counted and is not treated as zero. Average tokens includes only turns with reported tokens. Cache share uses only turns with valid input and cached-input counters. The cost_usd value prices each response with the matching short- or long-context rate.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let price = dynamic({
    "gpt-5.6-luna": {
        "short": {"i": 0.2, "cr": 0.02, "o": 1.2},
        "long": {"i": 0.4, "cr": 0.04, "o": 1.8}
    },
    "gpt-5.6-sol": {
        "short": {"i": 4.0, "cr": 0.4, "o": 20.0},
        "long": {"i": 8.0, "cr": 0.8, "o": 30.0}
    }
});
// Source: Prices() in trey-finops-hub/Hub for EA billing account 8611537.
// Rates are USD per 1 million tokens for Standard Global meters in the September 2026 price sheet.
let priceStart = datetime(2026-09-01);
let priceEnd = datetime(2026-10-01);
let streamParents = dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'receiving_stream'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId = id, samplingId = operation_ParentId;
let samplingModels = dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'try_run_sampling_request'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId = id, model = tostring(customDimensions['model']);
let responseCosts = dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         streamId = operation_ParentId
| where isnotnull(total)
| join kind=leftouter streamParents on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId
| join kind=leftouter samplingModels on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId
| extend valid_usage = input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input and output >= 0,
         context = iff(input > 272000, 'long', 'short'),
         uncached = input - cached
| extend modelPrice = price[model]
| extend p = modelPrice[context]
| extend response_cost_usd = iff(valid_usage and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd and isnotnull(p),
    (uncached * todouble(p.i) + cached * todouble(p.cr) + output * todouble(p.o)) / 1000000.0,
    real(null))
| summarize response_count = count(), priced_responses = countif(isnotnull(response_cost_usd)),
            response_cost_usd = sum(response_cost_usd) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id;
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_task.turn'
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions['model']),
         total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens'])
| extend model = iff(isempty(model), 'Not reported', model),
         valid_cache = input > 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input
| join kind=leftouter responseCosts on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id
| extend turn_priced = isnotnull(response_count) and response_count > 0 and priced_responses == response_count
| summarize turns = count(), turns_with_tokens = countif(total >= 0),
            total_tokens = sumif(total, total >= 0), avg_per_turn = avgif(total, total >= 0),
            p95_s = percentile(duration, 95) / 1000.0,
            input = sumif(input, valid_cache), cached = sumif(cached, valid_cache),
            priced_turns = countif(turn_priced), cost_usd_total = sumif(response_cost_usd, turn_priced) by model
| extend missing_usage = turns - turns_with_tokens,
         total_tokens = iff(turns_with_tokens > 0, total_tokens, real(null)),
         cache_pct = iff(input > 0, 100.0 * cached / input, real(null)),
         cost_usd = iff(priced_turns == turns, round(cost_usd_total, 4), real(null))
| project model, turns, turns_with_tokens, missing_usage, total_tokens, avg_per_turn, p95_s, cache_pct, cost_usd
| order by turns desc

         conversation = tostring(customDimensions['conversation.id']),
         call = tostring(customDimensions['call_id']),
         tool = tostring(customDimensions['tool_name']),
         outcome = tobool(customDimensions['success']),
         duration_ms = todouble(customDimensions['duration_ms'])
| where isnotempty(conversation) and isnotempty(call)
| extend tool = iff(isempty(tool), 'Not reported', tool)
| summarize timestamp = min(timestamp), outcomes = make_set_if(tostring(outcome), isnotnull(outcome), 3),
            durations = make_set(duration_ms, 3), tool = take_any(tool)
            by role, conversation, call
| extend outcome = iff(array_length(outcomes) == 1, tobool(outcomes[0]), bool(null)),
         duration_ms = iff(array_length(durations) == 1, todouble(durations[0]), real(null))
| join kind=leftanti (metricLatency | project role, tool) on role, tool
| where duration_ms >= 0
| summarize n = count(), avg_ms = avg(duration_ms), p50_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 50),
            p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95), max_ms = max(duration_ms) by tool
| extend source = 'Logs';
union
    (metricLatency
     | summarize n = sum(n), total_ms = sum(total_ms), max_ms = max(max_ms) by tool
     | extend avg_ms = total_ms / n, p50_ms = real(null), p95_ms = real(null), source = 'Metrics'
     | project-away total_ms),
    logLatency
| project tool, source, n, avg_ms, p50_ms, p95_ms, max_ms
| order by n desc

panels.description: Populations are deliberately separate: classic metrics describe completed tool calls; conversation-start logs describe each conversation latest observed policy in the selected window. These are not comparable denominators and are not combined into one pie. No enforcement or security guarantee is inferred.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
    (customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
     | where name == 'codex.tool.call'
     | extend policy = tostring(customDimensions['sandbox_policy'])
     | extend policy = iff(isempty(policy), 'Not reported', policy)
     | summarize observations = sum(valueSum) by policy
     | where observations > 0
     | extend population = 'Tool calls (metric)'),
    (traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
     | where tostring(customDimensions['event.name']) == 'codex.conversation_starts'
     | extend role = iff(cloud_RoleName == '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', cloud_RoleName), conversation = tostring(customDimensions['conversation.id']),
              policy = tostring(customDimensions['sandbox_policy'])
     | where isnotempty(conversation)
     | summarize arg_max(timestamp, policy) by role, conversation
     | extend policy = iff(isempty(policy), 'Not reported', policy)
     | summarize observations = todouble(count()) by policy
     | extend population = 'Conversations (latest policy)')
| project population, policy, observations
| order by population asc, observations desc

panels.description: Top 15 session_task.turn spans with reported turn-level token usage. Uses real thread and turn attributes. Missing IDs are not replaced by invented identifiers. The cost_usd value prices each response with the matching short- or long-context rate. Duration is the corresponding turn span, not a trace-wide maximum.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let price = dynamic({
    "gpt-5.6-luna": {
        "short": {"i": 0.2, "cr": 0.02, "o": 1.2},
        "long": {"i": 0.4, "cr": 0.04, "o": 1.8}
    },
    "gpt-5.6-sol": {
        "short": {"i": 4.0, "cr": 0.4, "o": 20.0},
        "long": {"i": 8.0, "cr": 0.8, "o": 30.0}
    }
});
// Source: Prices() in trey-finops-hub/Hub for EA billing account 8611537.
// Rates are USD per 1 million tokens for Standard Global meters in the September 2026 price sheet.
let priceStart = datetime(2026-09-01);
let priceEnd = datetime(2026-10-01);
let streamParents = dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'receiving_stream'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId = id, samplingId = operation_ParentId;
let samplingModels = dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'try_run_sampling_request'
| project cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId = id, model = tostring(customDimensions['model']);
let responseCosts = dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         streamId = operation_ParentId
| where isnotnull(total)
| join kind=leftouter streamParents on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, streamId
| join kind=leftouter samplingModels on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, samplingId
| extend valid_usage = input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input and output >= 0,
         context = iff(input > 272000, 'long', 'short'),
         uncached = input - cached
| extend modelPrice = price[model]
| extend p = modelPrice[context]
| extend response_cost_usd = iff(valid_usage and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd and isnotnull(p),
    (uncached * todouble(p.i) + cached * todouble(p.cr) + output * todouble(p.o)) / 1000000.0,
    real(null))
| summarize response_count = count(), priced_responses = countif(isnotnull(response_cost_usd)),
            response_cost_usd = sum(response_cost_usd) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id;
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_task.turn'
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions['model']),
         thread = tostring(customDimensions['thread.id']),
         turn = tostring(customDimensions['turn.id']),
         totalTokens = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']),
         cachedTokens = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.cached_input_tokens']),
         outputTokens = todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.output_tokens'])
| where totalTokens >= 0
| join kind=leftouter responseCosts on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id
| extend cost_usd = iff(isnotnull(response_count) and response_count > 0 and priced_responses == response_count,
    round(response_cost_usd, 4), real(null))
| project timestamp, model, thread, turn, totalTokens, cachedTokens, outputTokens, cost_usd, duration_s = duration / 1000.0
| order by totalTokens desc
| take 15

panels.description: p50 and p95 of session_task.turn span duration per Grafana interval, in seconds. Percentiles describe completed turns, not a model-only request population. Gaps remain gaps when no turn spans are observed.

azureLogAnalytics.query:

| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')

panels.description: Counts Codex dependency spans with an explicit http.response.status_code from 100 to 599. Uses the recorded HTTP status, not the compatibility success flag: HTTP 522 observations were marked success=True in both resources. Missing status is excluded, not assumed successful. This is not a whole-application success rate.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| extend status_code = toint(customDimensions['http.response.status_code'])
| where status_code between (100 .. 599)
| extend outcome = case(status_code >= 500, 'Server error', status_code >= 400, 'Client error',
                        status_code >= 300, 'Redirect', status_code >= 200, 'Success', 'Informational')
| summarize responses = count(), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95), last_seen = max(timestamp) by status_code, outcome
| order by status_code desc

panels.description: Record counts and last observations within the selected resource/time range. Tool metric points and raw tool logs are different representations, not tool-call totals; native logs can have duplicate copies. Missing optional signals are reported explicitly. Turns with token usage can be fewer than completed turns. Age is measured from the selected range end, not the current clock.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_init' | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Session initializations', source = 'dependencies'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_task.turn' | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Completed turn spans', source = 'dependencies'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'session_task.turn' | where isnotnull(todouble(customDimensions['codex.turn.token_usage.total_tokens']))
     | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Turns with token usage', source = 'dependencies'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server')
| where name == 'handle_responses'
| extend total = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.total_tokens']),
         input = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
         cached = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']),
         output = todouble(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
         reasoning = todouble(customDimensions['codex.usage.reasoning_output_tokens'])
| where isnotnull(total) | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Response token reports', source = 'dependencies'),
    (customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | where name == 'codex.tool.call'
     | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Tool-call metric points', source = 'customMetrics'),
    (traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | where tostring(customDimensions['event.name']) == 'codex.tool_result'
     | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Tool-result logs (raw, before deduplication)', source = 'traces'),
    (requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Application request spans', source = 'requests'),
    (dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ('codex-app-server', 'coding-agent.codex-app-server', '[coding-agent]/codex-app-server') | summarize records = count(), last_seen = max(timestamp) | extend signal = 'Application dependency spans', source = 'dependencies')
| extend age_s = todouble(datetime_diff('second', $__timeTo(), last_seen)),
         availability = iff(records > 0, 'Observed', 'Not observed in this resource/window')
| project signal, source, records, last_seen, age_s, availability
| order by signal asc
